answer: One defense binds each identity to a single piece of hardware: the agent key must live inside a tamper-evident module, a ferrous-sealed chip whose serial number is burned in at manufacture, so identities cannot be cloned like files. When a thousand fake agents all sign from one silicon fingerprint, the network sees through the masquerade like light through a prism and splits the swarm into its single source. New identities also start with glacier-slow trust limits, tiny job sizes that grow only after months of honest work, so a sybil army earns nothing faster than one patient honest node.
